assets.prompt: Create one landscape 16:9 background illustration for a cozy virtual-idol themed narrative convenience-store browser game, no characters. View from customer side across a clean low cream checkout counter in the foreground, eye-level perspective, rain on a large window with a quiet midnight indigo street outside, warm pendant lights, small lavender and peach accents, soft anime background illustration with detailed painted materials and gentle cel shading, inviting and calm. Left rear has small packaged goods shelves and a lit fridge with generic unlabelled bottles, right rear has the rainy window and a small potted plant. Leave the middle 50% visually quiet for an overlaid character portrait and the bottom third subdued for a game dialogue panel. Broad horizontal composition, clear spatial depth, readable at small sizes, soft luminous light, creamy ivory interior contrasted with blue violet exterior. No readable text, no letters, no logos, no user interface, no watermark. Production-ready game background, polished Japanese animation background art, not photorealistic.
